title: Nothing won't launch a new phone this year in its budget-focused CMF Phone series due to RAM prices (Ben Schoon/9to5Google)
summary: Ben Schoon / 9to5Google: Nothing won't launch a new phone this year in its budget-focused CMF Phone series due to RAM prices — Nothing's CMF Phone series has released two models thus far and, at least for now, won't be getting a third, as the rising cost of materials has essentially left the series dead in the water.
